title: Hearty Roasted Jamaican Chicken Roast
description: A malty and aerated weeknight Jamaican dish featuring katsuobushi, this roast is served on a talavera plate and is anti-inflammatory friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together curry powder, thyme, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken thighs, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken thighs until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add the scotch bonnet peppers to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 25 minutes.
Sprinkle the katsuobushi over the top of the chicken and continue to roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
